LESSON: READING 8.2.1 READING FLUENCY

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 8
Topic 8.2: Reading 8.2.1 Reading Fluency

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Reading 8.2.1 Reading Fluency. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why is it important to read at a reasonable speed? 2.How can you read a text fast?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read a text of about 300 words accurately, at the right speed and with expression for effective communication,
2. use fluency strategies to read a text of about 300 words related to the theme to enhance comprehension,
3. realise the importance of fluency in reading for comprehension. The learner is guided to: turns reading their parts from a script and bring the text alive through their voices (a reader’s theatre does not need any set or costumes and it is excellent for building fluency), about 300 words related to the theme in small groups, inferences in pairs and small groups from a text of about 300 words, indirect questions that require inferences, songs and poems, and repeat them, English songs, attention to rhythm. 1.Why is it important to read at a reasonable speed? 2.How can you read a text fast? 60

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Reading 8.2.1 Reading Fluency.
2. Explain Reading 8.2.1 Reading Fluency to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: read digital or non-digital texts of about 300 words related to the theme in small groups,
4. Show that you can: read a text of about 300 words accurately, at the right speed and with expression for effective communication,
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 8.2.1 Reading Fluency. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is it important to read at a reasonable speed? 2.How can you read a text fast?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read digital or non-digital texts of about 300 words related to the theme in small groups,
2. Read and sing lyrics of relevant English songs,
3. Read poems and rhymes while paying attention to rhythm. 1.
